question_redacted: What is the minimum attendance for B.Tech CSE students?
answer: The minimum attendance to appear in the end-semester examination is at least 80% (ATT-MIN-02, clause 2.1 of Circular on Revised Minimum Attendance, in force on 2026-10-06). Note: ACAD-REG-2024 clause 7.2 (>=75%) was superseded by ACAD-2026-08 effective 2026-08-01, so >=80% applies. Note: DEPT-FAQ-CSE clause 3.1 says >=65% but ACAD-2026-08 clause 2.1 has higher authority (level 2 against level 4), so >=80% applies.
explanation: step2 ACAD-REG-2024#7.2 superseded by ACAD-2026-08; step2 ACAD-REG-2024#7.2 superseded by ACAD-2026-08; topic 'min_attendance_pct': winner ACAD-2026-08#2.1 (level 2, effective 2026-08-01); 2 overridden ACAD-REG-2024 7.2 (level 1, effective 2024-07-01) says >=75% was explicitly superseded by ACAD-2026-08 (Official circulars and notifications from an authorised office, effective 2026-08-01); the earlier text is no longer applicable for 'min attendance pct'. ACAD-2026-08 2.1 (level 2, effective 2026-08-01) says >=80% prevails over DEPT-FAQ-CSE 3.1 (level 4, effective 2026-09-15) says >=65% because it has higher authority (level 2 vs level 4); date does not matter across authority levels. Rules and documents are applied as in force on 2026-10-06.
